notes: 2.0.1 — calibration runs finish much sooner (about 55 to 60 percent less time on five test setups; computers with 8 or 16 GB of memory gain even more), with results identical to 2.0.0 to the byte — nothing to re-run. The Session screen shows the measurement folder's name and measured date and offers a newer measurement with one click; two notes are worded more precisely.
